display_name: GitHub Copilot Chat for VS Code

clusters.title: Enhanced Configuration Settings and UI Fixes
clusters.summary: Users are requesting more granular control over agent behavior through configuration options, including export capabilities for Copilot plans, timeout settings for MCP server execution, and independent control over ask_questions auto-approval. Additionally, a bug in the Configure Tools UI that writes incorrect prefix notation to agent configuration files needs to be fixed.
clusters.representative_need: Add granular settings option to control ask_questions auto-approve behavior independently from other tools
sample_titles: Add granular settings option to control ask_questions auto-approve behavior independently from other tools
Add settings to automatically export Copilot plans to local markdown files for version control
Add timeout configuration options for MCP server tool execution

clusters.title: Fix Agent Mode reliability and tool integration issues
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues in Agent Mode including hanging behavior, MCP server failures, and tool crashes. Key problems include MCP servers not auto-starting, tools being disabled with Claude models, the ask_questions tool not returning selections, and #codebase search failures. Additionally, users want enhanced multi-agent capabilities with model parameter support for subagents and fresh session handoffs.
clusters.representative_need: Add optional model parameter to runSubagent tool for specifying subagent models
sample_titles: Add optional model parameter to runSubagent tool for specifying subagent models
Fix #codebase search functionality that crashes or fails with 'request failed' error after initiating codebase search
Fix MCP servers with autoStart:true not starting automatically on VS Code launch or chat session begin

clusters.title: AI and Copilot Integration Fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple issues with AI/Copilot functionality including model availability, connectivity errors, tool computation failures, and quota consumption problems. These issues prevent reliable use of AI features and require fixes to error handling, model access, and resource management.
clusters.representative_need: Enable AI to automatically read workspace files for review without manual context attachment
sample_titles: Enable AI to automatically read workspace files for review without manual context attachment
Fix 'Failed to compute args for tool: semantic_search' error
Fix 504 Gateway Timeout errors in Copilot extension

clusters.title: Improve Copilot Chat UI status visibility and feedback
clusters.summary: Users want improved visual feedback and status visibility in the Copilot Chat interface. This includes visible rate limit indicators showing quota usage and reset timing, source location transparency for custom prompts and skills, graceful handling of large responses, and fixing broken UI elements like stuck spinners that block interaction. These improvements would help users understand system state and work more effectively without being blocked by unresponsive UI.
clusters.representative_need: Add source location visibility to custom prompts and skills in the prompt picker
sample_titles: Add source location visibility to custom prompts and skills in the prompt picker
Add visible rate limit status indicators showing usage quota, reset countdown, and scope in Copilot Chat UI
Fix stuck spinner that blocks stop button and persists after VSCode restart

clusters.title: Improve custom prompts and skills management in CLI picker
clusters.summary: Users want better organization and visibility of custom prompts and skills in the command picker, including separating prompt files from skills with clear grouping, showing source locations, and fixing YAML validation for attributes like 'allowed-tools'. These improvements would help developers better manage, organize, and debug their custom extensions.
clusters.representative_need: Add source location visibility for custom prompts and skills in the prompt picker
sample_titles: Add source location visibility for custom prompts and skills in the prompt picker
Fix SKILL.md YAML validator to recognize 'allowed-tools' as a valid frontmatter attribute
Separate prompt files from skills/commands in the slash picker with grouping or distinct prefixes

clusters.title: Fix VS Code Extension Errors and Failures
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing various extension-related issues including initialization timeouts, unhandled promise rejections during shutdown, and compatibility problems with VS Code Insiders. They want these extension errors investigated and fixed to ensure extensions work reliably without crashing or failing to initialize.
clusters.representative_need: Fix GitHub Copilot Chat extension not working with VS Code Insiders
sample_titles: Fix GitHub Copilot Chat extension not working with VS Code Insiders
Fix extension initialization timeout failure
Handle closed debug channel gracefully during extension host shutdown to prevent unhandled promise rejections

clusters.title: Improve Copilot Chat reliability and session management
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple reliability issues with Copilot Chat including slow initialization, session persistence problems, context truncation causing lost message access, and accidental message deletion without confirmation. These issues frustrate users and impact productivity when the chat feature becomes unresponsive or loses important conversation history.
clusters.representative_need: Add confirmation or modifier key requirement to prevent accidental deletion of chat messages via Delete key
sample_titles: Add confirmation or modifier key requirement to prevent accidental deletion of chat messages via Delete key
Add display style setting for auto-approved terminal commands independent of approval status
Fix API version mismatch causing Chat extension activation failure when VS Code APIs are unavailable

clusters.title: API Request Error Handling and Model Compatibility
clusters.summary: Users encounter various API errors including server errors (500, 413), unsupported endpoint combinations, and serialization issues when making API requests. They want the system to either prevent these errors through better model/endpoint compatibility checks or handle them gracefully with clear, informative error messages. This includes fixing issues like malformed function_response serialization and preventing extension load failures when models aren't accessible via certain endpoints.
clusters.representative_need: Fix extension load failure when model is not accessible via /chat/completions endpoint
sample_titles: Fix extension load failure when model is not accessible via /chat/completions endpoint
Fix malformed function_response serialization when sending MCP tool responses to Gemini API
Fix model API endpoint compatibility to prevent errors when requesting unsupported model/endpoint combinations

clusters.title: Excessive Rate Limit Wait Times
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing unreasonably long rate limit wait times (455+ hours), making it impractical to continue using the platform. They are requesting either reduced rate limit thresholds or improved communication about when limits will reset so they can plan accordingly.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessively long rate limit wait time (455+ hours is impractical for users)
sample_titles: Fix excessively long rate limit wait time (455+ hours is impractical for users)
Reduce rate limit duration thresholds or provide better user communication about rate limits

clusters.title: Platform Support Expansion and Installation Bug Fixes
clusters.summary: Users want expanded platform support for the Copilot SDK (specifically linux-arm64 architecture) as well as fixes for installation-related bugs. The infinite loop issue when multiple VS Code installations are present causes reliability problems that prevent smooth usage of the SDK in complex development environments.
clusters.representative_need: Add linux-arm64 prebuild for pty.node in @github/copilot/sdk
sample_titles: Add linux-arm64 prebuild for pty.node in @github/copilot/sdk
Fix infinite loop in Find-RealCopilot when multiple VS Code installations are present

clusters.title: Fix AI Model Availability and Behavior Issues
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing critical issues with AI models not being accessible, available, or functioning correctly. They report problems with model endpoints, Copilot extensions, and AI assistants that delete code without providing alternatives. Users need these AI functionality issues resolved to maintain productive workflows.
clusters.representative_need: Fix AI assistant behavior that deletes user code without providing replacement content
sample_titles: Fix AI assistant behavior that deletes user code without providing replacement content
Fix GPT-5.4 model accessibility via /chat/completions endpoint
Fix language model unavailability in Copilot extension

clusters.title: Terminal task interruption and command parsing fixes
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing unexpected task interruptions without any warning or notification, which disrupts workflow. Additionally, command parsing fails when heredoc terminators are followed by additional commands, causing terminal tool execution errors. These issues affect the reliability and predictability of terminal operations.
clusters.representative_need: Fix command parsing to properly handle heredoc terminators followed by additional commands in terminal tool execution
sample_titles: Fix command parsing to properly handle heredoc terminators followed by additional commands in terminal tool execution
Fix tasks being interrupted without warning or notification

clusters.title: Fix subscription authentication and access issues
clusters.summary: Users with active Copilot Pro subscriptions are encountering authentication failures, subscription recognition errors, and access restrictions that prevent them from using AI features they've paid for. These issues include quota enforcement failures, rate limiting without clear messaging, and upgrade flow problems that block paying users from accessing the service.
clusters.representative_need: Add GitHub Copilot Enterprise authentication option to Codex extension, or display clear messaging when this subscription type is unsupported
sample_titles: Add GitHub Copilot Enterprise authentication option to Codex extension, or display clear messaging when this subscription type is unsupported
Fix API parameter compatibility for BYOK with newer OpenAI models by using 'max_completion_tokens' instead of 'max_tokens'
Fix Copilot Pro subscription not being recognized in VS Code despite having an active paid subscription

clusters.title: Improve Network Reliability and Error Recovery
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing frequent gateway timeout errors (504, 502) and false connectivity reports that disrupt their workflow. They want more stable connections during high-load periods and graceful handling of network failures with improved error recovery mechanisms.
clusters.representative_need: Fix constant 504 Gateway Timeout errors preventing Copilot usage
sample_titles: Fix constant 504 Gateway Timeout errors preventing Copilot usage
Fix false positive 'not connected to internet' errors when user has active connectivity
Handle network connectivity failures gracefully with better error recovery

clusters.title: Copilot Chat Rate Limits and Session Sync
clusters.summary: Users experience premature rate limiting that blocks paid users after minimal Copilot Chat usage, and they also want session history to sync between VS Code Stable and Insiders. These issues disrupt workflow continuity and reduce the value of Copilot Chat for paying customers who expect reliable, uninterrupted access to their conversations.
clusters.representative_need: Fix premature rate limiting that blocks paid users after minimal Copilot Chat usage
sample_titles: Fix premature rate limiting that blocks paid users after minimal Copilot Chat usage
Sync Copilot Chat session history between VS Code Stable and Insiders

clusters.title: Improve Copilot Chat reliability and initialization
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing reliability issues with Copilot Chat, including renderer crashes during heavy usage in Remote-SSH workspaces on macOS, slow initialization times, and infinite retry loops from unhandled HTTP 404 errors. They want a more stable and responsive Chat experience with faster startup times and proper error handling.
clusters.representative_need: Fix renderer crash during heavy Copilot Chat usage in Remote-SSH workspaces on macOS
sample_titles: Fix renderer crash during heavy Copilot Chat usage in Remote-SSH workspaces on macOS
Fix slow Chat initialization time
Handle HTTP 404 responses from org custom instructions API as non-retryable errors to prevent infinite retry loops
